control.description-key: Previews PDF files from related records as tabs with a native browser viewer and download

data-set.name: documents
data-set.description-key: The related records containing the PDF files (configure via the relationship/view when adding this as a subgrid)

property.name: fileColumnName
property.description-key: Logical (schema) name of the File column on the related table that holds the PDF, e.g. lops_pdffile

property.name: tabLabelColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of the column to use as the tab label. Defaults to the file name when left blank.

property.name: allowDownload
property.description-key: Show or hide the download button

property.name: showButtonLabels
property.description-key: Show text labels on the Open in new tab and Download buttons. When off, only the icons are shown, with the label available as a hover tooltip.

property.name: tabLabelMaxChars
property.description-key: Maximum number of characters to show in each tab label before truncating with an ellipsis. The full name is always available as a hover tooltip.

property.name: allowOpenRecord
property.description-key: Show an Open Record button that navigates to the Dataverse form for the record currently displayed in the viewer.

property.name: style
property.description-key: Layout of the document selector. Horizontal shows tabs above the preview. Vertical shows a document list to the right of the preview.

value.name: Horizontal
value.description-key: Document tabs shown in a row above the preview

value.name: Vertical
value.description-key: Document names shown in a vertical list to the right of the preview
